summary: Full frontend audit of MikiLab (guest + admin login) at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 430x900, IT/EN/DE/FA. Verified: bottom-nav peels (all 5 route correctly, aria-pressed=true), Home lab cards (Panetteria/Pizzeria/Pasticceria -> correct hubs), Motore Sfide overlay, weekly challenge, auth dialog + login as admin@mikilab.de (works, session persists, all tabs work after login), language switch + persistence (localStorage mikilab_lang, dir=rtl for FA), SiteMenu, Radio panel, AdminPanel, Ricette (category folders -> 59 recipe rows -> recipe dialog), Ricette Custodite (+ QR detail), Il Tuo Laboratorio tools (Calcolatore Idratazione, Calcolatore Metodo & Sequenze IA), Impara, Community. Programmatic palette scan (computed backgroundColor + gradients) and overflow/clipping scan on every section. NAVIGATION IS SOLID (no broken route found), but there are real palette violations (cream promo card, purple weekly-challenge, blue lab hero, invisible orange-on-orange and dark-on-dark text), 5 typos and several clipping/contrast issues.

minor.issue: Guest home fires repeated 401s (12+ per load) -> noisy console; gate the call or treat 401 as normal without logging

No close/X button in the dialog (only share/listen/handsfree/timer/print/scale icons). On mobile the dialog covers the whole screen and blocks the bottom nav -> user has no visible way out (only Esc / backdrop)
Validation text '⚠️ Obbligatorio: scegli almeno una ricetta e ...' rendered in rgb(36,36,36) on #121212 -> invisible error message
Labels 'MICHELE' rgb(58,82,51) and 'MOMY' rgb(39,64,56) are dark-on-dark, effectively unreadable
Crown admin button is NOT rendered for admin@mikilab.de (docs say data-testid=admin-btn in header). Admin panel is reachable only via ☰ -> site-menu-admin
Onboarding popup 'Ciao, sono Mohammadreza' still appears in Il Tuo Laboratorio although localStorage mikilab_lab_tour_done='1' was set -> flag key mismatch; popup overlays the tools grid
React console error 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' (hydration error). Also lang-select is a native <select>, so the dropdown is OS-rendered and cannot follow the dark/orange palette

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: click [data-testid=login-btn], then scope the fields to [data-testid=auth-modal] (a bare input[type=email] selector hits the newsletter input behind the modal), then click the 'Accedi' submit (.last). Recipes: nav-tab-ricette -> click [data-testid=cat-folder-pane] to reveal recipe-row-* (59 rows), then recipe dialog opens (no X button, use Escape). Lab tools: nav-tab-maestro -> capo-quicklink-<id>; 'Calcolatore Metodo & Sequenze IA' is capo-quicklink-sequenze (capo-quicklink-metodo is the Hydration calculator - naming is confusing but both work). Custodite: text link 'Ricette Custodite' -> custodite-hero -> custodite-open-*. Palette scan approach: evaluate computed backgroundColor AND backgroundImage gradients (violations were only in gradients), and check text color for orange-static / dark-on-dark.
rca_of_the_issue: The theme overhaul was applied mainly through index.css overrides (body #121212 and a .text-[#ff6b00] -> white rule), which cannot reach Tailwind gradient utilities (bg-gradient-to-br from-... to-...) nor inline dark hex text colors. Consequently every remaining violation lives inside component gradients/hex classes: home-hero (cream #F7EFE0 + brown text), home-weekly-challenge & weekly-theme-card (purple #4A2E78), Maestro hero (blue #2F6A97), plus auth-tab-login where the same orange token was used for both text and background.
